scope: BookiE B4-22 release-binary GTK acceptance for confirmed connection-bundle export and import
worktree_state: GTK test source has local uncommitted changes; source hash identifies the tested scenarios
binary_build: scripts/test-gtk-safety.sh built cargo build --release --locked -p tablepro-app --bin tablepro-app and installed it at target/installed/usr/bin/tablepro

scenarios.name: bundle_export_records_sanitized_audit_outcome
assertions: export action creates selected bundle file
audit journal contains exactly one durable intent and one outcome with a shared operation ID
audit records contain only the aggregate affected count and omit destination path

scenarios.name: bundle_import_records_sanitized_audit_outcome
assertions: preview appears before a connection is saved
confirmation saves the selected connection and preserves unmentioned connections
audit journal contains exactly one durable intent and one outcome with a shared operation ID
audit records contain only the aggregate affected count and omit bundle path and connection name

not_established: encrypted bundle unlock and credential replacement in the GTK flow
